articles.headline: UAE Closes Beaches Following Regional Oil Spill
articles.brief: Authorities in the United Arab Emirates have ordered the immediate closure of all beaches in Ras Al Khaimah as neighboring areas grapple with a significant offshore oil spill.

articles.headline: Mass Protests And Clashes Rock France
articles.brief: France faces widespread unrest as thousands march against inequality and living costs. Police reported arresting nearly a thousand individuals amid escalating violence in Paris and other regions.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh Prepares For Severe Cyclone Landfall
articles.brief: India's eastern coast is on high alert as a intensifying depression in the Bay of Bengal threatens to strike Andhra Pradesh as a very severe cyclonic storm next week.

articles.headline: Trump Hints At Potential Fresh Strikes On Iran
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump has hinted at possible new military actions against Iran as tensions mount, while Tehran continues to deny offering any formal regional deal.

articles.headline: China Urges US To Halt Outbound Investment Curbs
articles.brief: Beijing has formally urged Washington to halt its proposed expansion of outbound investment restrictions, warning that the measures threaten global economic stability and market confidence.

articles.headline: Johnson & Johnson Prostate Cancer Drug Shows Promise
articles.brief: Early-stage clinical trials indicate that Johnson & Johnson's new prostate cancer therapeutic successfully shrinks tumors, offering renewed hope for effective targeted treatments.

articles.headline: India Achieves Milestone With 300th T20I Match
articles.brief: The Indian men's cricket team has made history by playing its 300th T20 International and securing its 200th victory in the format following a thrilling run chase against New Zealand.

articles.headline: Lindt Chairman Admits Pricing Strategy Missteps
articles.brief: The chairman of chocolate maker Lindt has acknowledged that the company miscalculated its recent price hikes, following the high-profile ouster of its chief executive officer.

articles.headline: Indian Physicist Ashoke Sen Awarded Oskar Klein Medal
articles.brief: Renowned Indian physicist Ashoke Sen has been honored with the prestigious 2026 Oskar Klein Medal for his pioneering contributions to string theory, gravity, and black-hole physics.
